name: Paracetamol
uses: Fever, headache, body aches, mild to moderate pain
sideEffects: Rare; nausea or liver strain in heavy overdose

name: Sunscreen (SPF 50)
uses: Protection against UV rays, prevents tanning & sunburn
dosage: Apply 2 finger lengths on face & neck 15 mins before sun
sideEffects: Mild eye stinging or breakouts in oily skin

name: Salicylic Acid (2%)
uses: Treats acne, blackheads, whiteheads, unclogs pores
dosage: 2-3 drops on clean dry face at night, 2-3 times/week
sideEffects: Mild dryness, peeling, or tingling sensation

name: ORS (Oral Rehydration Salts)
uses: Dehydration due to diarrhea, vomiting, or heavy sweating
dosage: Dissolve 1 packet in 1 litre of clean drinking water
sideEffects: None when diluted in correct water quantity

name: Niacinamide (10%)
uses: Fades dark spots, controls oil, strengthens skin barrier
dosage: 2-3 drops morning and evening before moisturizer
sideEffects: Mild redness or flushing in sensitive skin

name: Cetirizine (10mg)
uses: Runny nose, sneezing, itching, hives, watery eyes
dosage: 1 tablet (10mg) once daily, preferably at night
